query: How do review themes differ between positive and negative Yelp sentiment?

per_column.name: staff_attentiveness
per_column.rationale: Categorizing staff responsiveness gives a strong new axis to compare positive vs negative review themes. Values are mostly well-grounded (YLP-0002 'forgot us twice' -> inattentive_ignored is spot-on; YLP-0005 no staff attention info -> not_present is correct). However YLP-0003 ('Service was good') maps to attentive_responsive reasonably, but YLP-0001 and YLP-0004 assert 'attentive_responsive' where the text speaks to friendliness/professionalism rather than explicit attentiveness/responsiveness, a mild over-read.

per_column.name: staff_demeanor
per_column.rationale: Demeanor (friendly/rude/indifferent) is a distinct and analytically useful theme axis for this sentiment comparison. Grounding is generally sound: YLP-0001 'always friendly and composed' -> friendly_professional; YLP-0005 discriminatory/exclusionary behavior -> rude_hostile is defensible. YLP-0002 'indifferent_dismissive' is a reasonable inference from repeated forgetting. YLP-0003 has no explicit demeanor statement, so friendly_professional is a mild unwarranted inference.

per_column.name: food_taste_flavor
per_column.rationale: Food quality/flavor is a core theme differentiating restaurant reviews and useful for the query. Values are well-grounded: YLP-0001 (loves the pita/fries) and YLP-0003 ('very good pizza') -> delicious_flavorful_fresh; YLP-0004 (real estate agent, no food) and YLP-0005 -> not_present are correct. YLP-0002 null for a silent row is acceptable behavior.

judge.rationale: All three added columns give genuine, distinct thematic axes (staff attentiveness, staff demeanor, food taste) that directly support comparing themes across positive and negative sentiment. None are near-constant, trivially redundant, or generic sentiment restatements. Grounding is strong overall: most produced values are sound readings of the source text, and 'not_present'/null on silent rows is handled correctly. Minor over-reads occur where attentiveness/demeanor are inferred from adjacent-but-not-explicit cues (e.g., inferring attentiveness from friendliness), slightly lowering groundedness for the two staff columns.
